definitions.explanation: A genre of Japanese young-adult fiction, typically published in paperback with anime-style illustrations. Abbreviation of ライトノベル.

examples.japanese: このラノベはアニメ{化|か}された。
examples.english: This light novel was adapted into an anime.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}のラノベは{異世界|いせかい}ものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Recent light novels often feature isekai (other-world) settings.

notes:
ラノベ is a widely used abbreviation of ライトノベル (light novel). It refers to a genre of Japanese fiction aimed primarily at a young-adult audience, characterized by accessible prose and anime-style cover illustrations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラノベを{読|よ}む: to read a light novel
- ラノベ{原作|げんさく}: based on a light novel
- ラノベ{作家|さっか}: light novel author

RELATED TERMS:
- ライトノベル: full form
- {漫画|まんが}: manga
- アニメ{化|か}: anime adaptation
